situation: I'm Aisha in 4B. The new neighbour directly below us smokes on his balcony every night around 10 and it comes straight into our bedroom window. Never met him. Building rules allow balcony smoking, so I'd just like him to use the far end by the railing in the evenings.
reply: Hi, I'm Aisha from 4B, right above you, and welcome to the building! I'm not sure you'd know, but smoke from your balcony drifts straight up into our bedroom window, mostly around 10pm. Would you mind using the far end by the railing in the evenings? Thanks, and let me know if anything from our side ever bothers you too.
note: Smoking is allowed here, so ask for something he can easily do rather than asking him to stop.

situation: El 28 de agosto le comenté a mi vecino Javier que su perro, Toby, ladraba horas cuando ellos trabajaban, y desde entonces lo saca a pasear un chico a mediodía. Ahora casi no se oye, solo un rato hacia las 8 de la mañana cuando se van. Yo trabajo desde casa y quiero darle las gracias sin que parezca que sigo quejándome.
reply: Hola, Javier. Solo quería darte las gracias: desde que hablamos el 28 de agosto se nota muchísimo la diferencia con Toby, y trabajando desde casa lo agradezco de verdad. Lo único que se oye aún es un rato hacia las 8, cuando os vais; si alguna vez se os ocurre algo para ese momento, genial, y si no, tampoco pasa nada. Y si algo de nuestra casa os molesta, dímelo sin problema.
note: Cuando el vecino ya ha cambiado, agradécelo primero; lo que queda se menciona de pasada y sin presión, para que el gesto no parezca otra queja.

situation: On Monday I knocked on my neighbour Greg's door about his contractor's van blocking our shared driveway every morning, so I can't get out to take the kids to school by 8:15. He got angry and said I'm 'always complaining'. There's room on the street in front of his house, and I want to follow up in writing a few days later.
reply: Hi Greg, our chat on Monday landed badly and that wasn't my aim. The only thing I'm asking is that the van isn't parked across the shared driveway before 8:15, so I can get the kids to school. Could the crew park on the street in front of yours in the mornings? Happy to talk whenever suits you.
note: Don't argue the 'always complaining' point. Shrink the ask to one time window; if it continues, tell him before you go to anyone else.

situation: 我是1402的刘洋。楼上1502在装修，小区规定周末不能施工，可他们9月12日、19日、26日连续三个周六早上8点就开电钻，每次两三个小时，我都记了时间、录了音。我9月13号和20号当面找过两次，也跟他们说了再这样就找物业。现在想正式给物业发消息。
reply: 物业您好，我是1402的业主刘洋，想正式反映楼上1502周末施工的问题。按小区装修规定周末不能施工，但9月12日、19日、26日这三个周六，早上8点左右就开始用电钻，每次两三个小时。我9月13日和20日两次当面跟1502的业主沟通过，也提前说了会找物业，情况没有变化。每次的时间记录和录音附在后面。麻烦您这周五之前跟对方确认一下施工时间，处理结果也请告诉我一声，谢谢。
note: 升级到物业时写清日期、次数和已经做过的沟通，不说“天天吵”这种记录撑不住的话。

situation: I'm Dan at number 14. Our elderly neighbour Mrs Hughes has a big hedge that's grown over our fence and now blocks most of the light to our vegetable beds. We've lived here 6 months and only waved hello. Our gardener could trim it back to the fence line on our side on Saturday 10 October, at our cost.
reply: Hi Mrs Hughes, it's Dan from number 14 next door, we've waved but never properly met. Your hedge has grown quite a way over our fence and is shading most of our vegetable beds now. Would you be OK with us having our gardener trim it back to the fence line on our side, at our cost? He's coming Saturday 10 October, and we'll leave your side exactly as it is. Do knock if anything from our side ever bothers you.
note: Introduce yourself, make the ask small and costless for her, and give the date so she isn't surprised by the noise.

situation: I'm Sofia in 3A. Mr. Brennan in 2A, below us, left a polite note saying our 3-year-old's running and thumping wakes him before 7am. He's right, our son is up at 6. We've ordered a thick hallway rug arriving Friday and will keep him playing in his back room until 7, but we can't stop a toddler running.
reply: Hi Mr. Brennan, it's Sofia from 3A. Thank you for the kind note, and sorry about the early wake-ups; we had no idea how much carries. We've ordered a thick rug for the hallway that arrives Friday, and we'll keep him playing in his room at the back until 7. It won't be silent, he's three, but it should be a lot better. Please knock if it's still bad after the weekend.
note: When you're the noise: thank them, say exactly what you'll change and by when, and be honest about what you can't.

situation: 我是5单元1101的陈磊，微信号chenlei1101。我们家在地下车库买了B-117车位，编号有点淡，最近两周有四个晚上被一辆白色SUV占了。保安说可能是3单元602的车。我不认识他们，想写张纸条塞他家门缝里。
reply: 602的邻居您好，我是5单元1101的陈磊。地下车库B-117是我们家的车位，最近两周有四个晚上停了一辆白色SUV，保安说可能是您家的车。车位上的编号有点淡，确实不太好认。以后能麻烦您停到访客车位吗？谢谢！我们这边如果有什么打扰到您，也请直接找我，微信号chenlei1101。
note: 第一次先塞门缝或当面说，不贴车窗；给对方一个台阶（编号淡），只提一个具体请求，并留下联系方式。

situation: I'm Maria at number 23. The couple next door in our terrace, Kyle and Jess, have had loud music past 1am most Saturdays since August. I asked them in person on 22 August and put a note through their door on 12 September. It happened again on the 19th and the 26th. We rent from the same letting agent and I want to warn them before I contact the agent.
reply: Hi Kyle and Jess, it's Maria from number 23 again. I've asked a couple of times about the music after 1am, and it's still happening on Saturdays, most recently the 19th and the 26th. I'd much rather sort it between us: could the volume come down by midnight? If it carries on, I'll raise it with the letting agent, and I wanted you to hear that from me first.
note: Tell them before you escalate, with dates from your log. An announced escalation often fixes it without the agent ever getting involved.

situation: I'm Claire at 41. Our neighbour Tony put up a new fence in August, and going by our 2019 property survey it's about a foot onto our side. I raised it with him on Sept 12 and he insisted his old fence was in the same spot. Before anyone mentions lawyers, I'd like to offer to split the cost of a surveyor, or try community mediation together.
reply: Hi Tony, it's Claire from 41. I've been thinking about our chat on the 12th, and I don't want a fence to come between us. Our 2019 survey puts the boundary about a foot closer to your house than where the new fence stands, and I know you remember the old fence differently. Would you be open to splitting the cost of a licensed surveyor to mark the line, with both of us going by what they find? If you'd rather talk it through with someone neutral first, I'm happy to look into whether there's a community mediation service near us and go along.
note: When the facts themselves are disputed, propose a neutral way to settle them that you both accept in advance. Boundary rules vary by area, so check local guidance before anyone mentions lawyers.

situation: I'm Priya at no. 12. The flat next door, no. 14, is a short-term holiday let. The owner, Graham, lives in Manchester and I got his email from the building's residents list. Guests had loud parties past 2am on Saturday Sept 12, 19 and 26, with people shouting on the balcony. I've never met him.
reply: Hi Graham, I'm Priya from no. 12, next door to your flat. You may not hear about this from the guests, so I wanted to let you know directly: there were loud parties past 2am on Saturday 12, 19 and 26 September, with music and people out on the balcony. Could you add quiet hours after 11pm to the house rules and the listing? Thanks, and do let me know if anything from our side ever causes trouble for your guests.
note: An absent owner usually doesn't know: introduce yourself, give dated facts, and ask for something he controls, like the house rules.

situation: 我是602的小孙，电话13800000006，晚上和周末都方便。我家卫生间天花板这两周一直往下渗水，吊顶都鼓起来了。物业来看过，说大概率是楼上702卫生间防水坏了。我不认识702的住户，想先给他们留张纸条约个时间。
reply: 您好，我是楼下602的住户，姓孙。这两周我家卫生间天花板一直在渗水，吊顶已经鼓起来了，物业看过说可能是楼上卫生间防水的问题，您那边可能完全没察觉。能不能这周找个时间，让物业的师傅上去看一下？方便的话打我电话13800000006，晚上和周末都可以。也欢迎您下来看看我家的情况，给您添麻烦了。
note: 漏水越拖越严重，先友好约时间，同时拍照并请物业留记录，之后谈维修费用时有据可查。

situation: I'm Hannah at number 18. Our next-door neighbour, Dev, has put up a camera on his side wall that points straight into our back garden and kitchen window. We've only ever nodded hello. I'd like to ask him to angle it away without starting a row.
reply: Hi Dev, it's Hannah from number 18 next door. I noticed the new camera on your side wall looks straight into our garden and kitchen window, which feels a bit exposed when we're out there. Would you mind angling it so it only covers your side path, or blocking out our side in the app if it has that option? Thanks, and let me know if anything from our side ever bothers you.
note: Ask for a two-minute adjustment, not removal, and leave the law out of a first message. If it stays as it is, check your local guidance before escalating.

situation: 202号室の中村です。隣の203号室の方が、燃えるゴミを収集日の前の晩に出していて、夜のうちにカラスが袋を破り集積所が散らかっています。掲示板には当日の朝8時までに出すよう書いてあり、今週も月曜の夜に出ていました。まだちゃんと話したことがないので、手紙をポストに入れたいです。
reply:
203号室の方へ
隣の202号室の中村と申します。ご挨拶が遅れてすみません。最近、燃えるゴミが収集日の前の晩に出ていることがあり、夜のうちにカラスが袋を破って集積所が散らかってしまっています。ご存じなかったかもしれませんが、掲示板にある通り、当日の朝8時までに出していただけると助かります。こちらの生活音などで気になることがあれば、いつでも声をかけてください。
202号室 中村
note: 名乗って、責めずに事実とお願いを一つだけ。管理会社に言うのは、直接伝えても変わらなかったとき。

situation: I'm Sam at number 7. The guy at number 9, Craig, warms up his motorbike on the street at about 5:30am most weekdays, revving it for 5 to 10 minutes. The neighbours at 11 (Daniel and Hana Abebe, who have a baby) and 13 (Ruth Clarke) have agreed we send him one joint note signed by all of us. None of us really know him.
reply:
Hi Craig, we're your neighbours either side and across: Sam at number 7, Daniel and Hana Abebe at 11, and Ruth Clarke at 13. You may not know how far it carries, but when the bike warms up outside at about 5:30 on weekday mornings, the revving wakes all three of our households, including the Abebes' baby. Could you roll it to the end of the road before starting it, or keep the warm-up to a minute or two? Thanks, and knock on any of our doors if something from our side ever bothers you.
Sam (7), Daniel and Hana (11), Ruth (13)
note: A joint note names only the households who agreed to sign. That adds weight without turning it into a campaign.

situation: I'm Tom at number 4. Linda at no. 6 posted in our 60-person street group chat that 'someone at number 4' has left their bins out all week and it's attracting rats. It's us: we've been away since last Tuesday looking after my mum in hospital, and my brother-in-law has just brought them in and will cover collection days. I want to reply to her, not in the group.
reply: Hi Linda, it's Tom from number 4. I saw your post about the bins, and you're right, they've been out since last Tuesday. We've been away looking after my mum in hospital and they slipped our minds. My brother-in-law has brought them in today and will handle collection days until we're back. Next time, please just message me or knock directly; I'd much rather hear it from you first.
note: When you're the one being called out in public: fix it, reply privately, and make the ask to come to you directly one calm line, not a telling-off.

situation: I'm Chris at 24. Last week I put a note through to Mrs Patel at 22 asking her to angle her new garage floodlight away from our bedroom window. She replied today that she'll look at it, but that our dog Bramble barks in the garden early in the mornings. She's right: he barks when we let him out at about 6:30, and from Monday we'll take him out the front on the lead instead.
reply: Hi Mrs Patel, thanks for getting back to me, and you're right about Bramble. He barks when we let him out at about 6:30, and I hadn't realised how much it carries. From Monday we'll take him out the front on the lead instead of into the garden. Thanks too for looking at the light; angled towards your drive it would sort things for us. Do tell me if he's still bothering you after that.
note: When your request gets a counter-complaint, own the fair part and fix it first, then keep your original ask to one calm line instead of trading grievances.

situation: Mein Nachbar Jonas wohnt Wand an Wand mit uns und übt jeden Tag von 18 bis 20 Uhr Schlagzeug. Ich habe ihn am 20. September freundlich angesprochen, und er meinte, laut Hausordnung sei Musik bis 20 Uhr erlaubt. Das stimmt, aber unsere zwei kleinen Kinder gehen um 19 Uhr ins Bett, und ihr Zimmer liegt direkt an seiner Wand. Ich bin Katrin.
reply: Hallo Jonas, hier ist Katrin von nebenan. Du hast recht, laut Hausordnung ist Musik bis 20 Uhr in Ordnung, und ich will dir das Üben auch nicht nehmen. Es geht mir nur um die Uhrzeit: Unsere beiden Kleinen gehen um 19 Uhr ins Bett, und ihr Zimmer liegt genau an deiner Wand. Könntest du an den meisten Tagen schon um 17 Uhr anfangen, damit um 19 Uhr Schluss ist? Sag gern Bescheid, wenn dich von unserer Seite auch mal etwas stört.
note: Wenn der Nachbar im Recht ist, nicht über die Regel streiten, sondern um eine kleine Verschiebung bitten, die er leicht geben kann.

situation: 我是501的小何。对门502的阿姨最近在楼道里堆了很多纸箱和一个旧沙发，挡住了半边楼梯，我推婴儿车下楼得侧着过，晚上楼道灯暗，也怕有人绊倒。平时见面会点头，但没怎么说过话。要搬下楼的话，我周六上午可以帮她。
reply: 阿姨您好，我是对门501的小何，平时见面点点头，一直没好好打个招呼。楼道里的纸箱和旧沙发挡了半边楼梯，我推婴儿车得侧着过，晚上灯暗，也怕有人不小心绊倒。能麻烦您这周挪一挪吗？要是需要搬下楼，我周六上午可以帮您一起搬。您那边有什么需要，也随时敲我家门。
note: 先当面或留字条，别发业主群；楼道是逃生通道，两次没变化就找物业处理，并提前跟她说一声。

situation: We share a gravel driveway with Alan and Sue at number 16, and our deeds say it's jointly maintained. The potholes have got deep since last winter and I've had a quote of £1,300 to regrade and resurface the whole thing. We're friendly but have never talked money; I'd like to split it 50/50 and I'm happy to get a second quote first. I'm Kate at number 14.
reply: Hi Alan and Sue, it's Kate from number 14. The potholes on our shared drive have got quite deep since last winter, and I've had a quote of £1,300 to regrade and resurface the whole thing. As the deeds have it as jointly maintained, would you be happy to split it, £650 each? I'm glad to get a second quote first if you'd like to compare. Let me know what you think.
note: Ask before any work starts; billing a neighbour afterwards turns a shared cost into a dispute.

situation: 我叫陈静，住702，孩子5岁。楼下602嫌吵，我们已经铺了地垫，晚上9点后也不让孩子跑跳。9月26日晚上11点左右他上楼踹我家门、大声骂人，孩子吓哭了；9月28日晚上又用杆子捅天花板半个多小时。我不想再跟他当面沟通，想正式给物业李经理发消息。
reply: 李经理您好，我是702的业主陈静，想正式反映楼下602住户的问题。我家孩子5岁，我们已经铺了地垫，晚上9点后也不让孩子跑跳。9月26日晚上11点左右，602住户上楼踹我家门并大声辱骂，孩子被吓哭；9月28日晚上又用杆子捅天花板半个多小时。出于安全考虑，我不打算再和他当面沟通，麻烦物业出面处理并做好记录，如果7楼楼道有监控，请先保存9月26日晚上的录像。方便的话这周给我回个电话，谢谢！
note: 踹门、辱骂已经是骚扰，不是调解能解决的：现在就可以报警留下记录，别再跟他当面谈；他再踹门或威胁时别开门，直接打110。给物业的消息只写事实和日期。

situation: 我是701的小吴。楼下601的邻居昨天在我家门上贴了张纸条，说我家每天半夜12点后有拖椅子和走路的声音。可我这两周都在外地出差，9月28日才回来，家里一直没人。我想回张纸条说明一下，也愿意帮他一起弄清楚声音是从哪来的。
reply: 601的邻居您好，我是楼上701的小吴，看到您的纸条了，谢谢您直接告诉我。这两周我在外地出差，9月28日才回来，这段时间家里一直没人，所以半夜的声音应该不是从我家来的。被吵到确实很难受，我也想帮您弄清楚是哪里的声音。下次再听到的时候，能麻烦您记一下时间告诉我吗？我对照一下当时家里的情况。
note: 被误会时先谢对方直接说，用事实说明，不猜是别家，再主动一起找来源；吵架只会让下一次沟通更难。

situation: I'm Rob at number 31. On Sunday a football from next door at 33, where Grace and Emeka Nwosu live with their two boys, came over the fence and cracked a pane in our greenhouse; a glazier has quoted £85 to replace it. We get on fine and I'm happy for the boys to keep playing, I'd just like the pane paid for.
reply: Hi Grace and Emeka, it's Rob from number 31. On Sunday one of the boys' footballs came over and cracked a pane in our greenhouse. Accidents happen, and we're glad they've got the garden to play in. The glazier has quoted £85 to replace it; would you be OK covering that? I'm happy to send you the quote, and do tell me if anything from our side ever bothers you.
note: One ask only: if balls keep coming over, raise where the goal stands in a later message.

situation: 我是902的小郑。对门901的邻居这两周每天晚上把电动车推进楼道，从家里拉电线出来充电，一充就是一整夜。物业公告写了禁止在楼道给电动车充电，楼下院子里有充电桩。我还没跟他们说过话，想先留张字条。
reply: 901的邻居您好，我是对门902的小郑。最近晚上看到电动车在楼道里充电，一充就是一整夜。楼道是大家的逃生通道，电池充电万一出问题，我们两家在同一层，挺让人担心的。物业公告里也写了楼道不能充电，楼下院子里有充电桩，以后能麻烦您推到楼下去充吗？您家要是有什么需要帮忙的，也随时敲我家门。
note: 安全问题也先友好地直接说；一旦闻到焦味或看到冒烟，马上离开并打119。没改善再找物业，并提前告诉对方。

situation: I'm Megan at number 5. Our neighbours at number 7, Paul and Gita, had a heat pump installed last month on their side wall, about two metres from our bedroom window, and it hums loudly most nights from about 11pm to 6am. We get on fine but have never had to raise anything like this, and I want to put a note through their door.
reply: Hi Paul and Gita, it's Megan from number 5. You probably can't hear it from inside, but the new heat pump on your side wall is about two metres from our bedroom window, and it hums quite loudly most nights from around 11pm to 6am. Would you be willing to ask your installer whether it has a quiet or night mode, or whether a screen would help? I'm happy to pop round and talk it through, and do tell me if anything from our side ever bothers you. Megan
note: Ask them to check with their installer, not to switch it off; if nothing changes, check local guidance on noise and tell them before you go to the council.

situation: Je suis Claire, au 3e. Ma voisine du dessus, Mme Lefèvre au 4e, nourrit les pigeons sur son balcon tous les matins ; depuis septembre, une dizaine de pigeons se posent sur ma rambarde et mon balcon est couvert de fientes, je le nettoie deux fois par semaine. On se dit bonjour dans l'escalier, sans plus, et je veux glisser un mot dans sa boîte aux lettres.
reply: Bonjour Madame Lefèvre, c'est Claire, votre voisine du 3e, juste en dessous de chez vous. Vous ne le voyez sans doute pas d'en haut, mais depuis septembre une dizaine de pigeons se posent chaque matin sur ma rambarde, et mon balcon est couvert de fientes : je le nettoie deux fois par semaine. Est-ce que vous accepteriez de ne plus leur donner à manger sur votre balcon ? Merci beaucoup, et n'hésitez pas à me dire si quelque chose chez nous vous gêne aussi. Claire, 3e étage
note: Une seule demande, ce qu'elle peut faire elle-même, sans juger son habitude ; le syndic seulement si rien ne change, et après l'avoir prévenue.

situation: 我住在城郊的独栋小院，隔壁老周家今年夏天开始养了一只公鸡，鸡笼就挨着我们卧室那面墙，每天凌晨四点半左右就开始打鸣，我和老公都会被吵醒。两家关系一直不错，平时常互相送菜。要是他愿意挪鸡笼，我们周末可以过去帮忙。
reply: 老周，跟您商量个小事。您家公鸡的笼子挨着我们卧室那面墙，每天凌晨四点半左右就开始打鸣，我和老公基本都会被吵醒。不是要您别养，就是想问问能不能把鸡笼挪到院子另一头，或者晚上给笼子盖块遮光布，看能不能让它晚点叫？要搬的话，我们周末过来搭把手。我们家要是有什么打扰到您的，也随时说。
note: 关系好的邻居，不要求他不养，只提他做得到的小调整，并主动帮忙；改善不了再查当地规定，提前跟他说一声再找村里或社区。

situation: I'm Ellen Cho at 15 Birch Road. The dog next door at number 17 barks for hours on weekday mornings while the owners are at work, usually from about 9am to 1pm; my log since 1 August has it on 31 weekdays. I spoke to the owners on 6 August, put a note through on 3 September, and told them on 24 September I'd contact the council. Now I'm writing to the council's noise team.
reply:
Dear Noise Team,
I'm writing about ongoing dog barking from 17 Birch Road, next door to my home at number 15. Since 1 August the dog has barked for long periods on weekday mornings, usually from about 9am to 1pm, on 31 weekdays so far; my log with dates and times is attached. I raised it with the owners in person on 6 August and by note on 3 September, and told them on 24 September that I would contact you. Could you let me know what the next step is?
Thank you,
Ellen Cho
note: The council letter is the last rung: the log, the dates you raised it, and proof you warned them first, with no comment on the owners themselves.

situation: 我是1203的小苏，女儿5岁，以前被狗咬过，特别怕狗。同一层1205的邻居养了一只金毛，这两周有三次在电梯里没牵绳，狗直接凑到我女儿身边，她吓得大哭。还没跟他们说过话，想先留张字条。
reply: 1205的邻居您好，我是同一层1203的小苏。您家金毛看着很温顺，您可能也没注意到：这两周有三次在电梯里没牵绳，狗直接凑到了我女儿身边。她5岁，以前被狗咬过，特别怕狗，每次都吓得大哭。以后在电梯和楼道里，能麻烦您给它牵上绳吗？我们这边有什么打扰到您的，也随时敲门跟我说。
note: 不评价狗也不评价主人，只提一个马上能做到的请求；没改善再找物业，并提前告诉对方。如果狗扑人或咬人，马上找物业并报警。

situation: I'm Nora at number 20. Since our neighbours at 22, Marcus and Lily Shaw, started knocking through their kitchen on 7 September, two cracks have appeared on our side of the shared living-room wall, one about 40cm long, and I've photographed them with dates. We've chatted over the fence a few times and get on fine.
reply: Hi Marcus and Lily, it's Nora from number 20. Since your kitchen work started on 7 September, two cracks have appeared on our side of the shared living-room wall, one about 40cm long; I've taken dated photos. I'm not jumping to conclusions about the cause, I'd just like it looked at early while it's easy to sort. Could your builder pop round this week to have a look? Happy to show either of you too, whenever suits.
note: Keep the dated photos, and check whether a party wall agreement or local rules apply before raising who pays. If the cracks grow quickly, contact the council's building control team.

situation: I'm Leo at number 9. In September my neighbour at number 11, Mrs Dunn, hung a big set of metal wind chimes outside her back door, about three metres from our bedroom window, and on windy nights they clang till morning. She once told me they were a present from her late husband, so I don't want her to take them down, just maybe bring them in at night; I could move the hook for her. We chat over the fence most weeks.
reply: Hi Mrs Dunn, it's Leo from next door. You told me the wind chimes were a present from your husband, so this isn't about taking them down. They're only about three metres from our bedroom window, though, and on windy nights they clang right through till morning. Would you be happy to bring them in at night, or hang them round the other side of the house? I'm glad to pop over and move the hook for you, and do tell me if anything from our side ever bothers you.
note: When the object matters to them, say first that you're not asking for it gone, then ask for the smallest change that fixes the nights.

situation: I'm Tara in flat 2, directly above Bella Cucina, the restaurant on the ground floor. Their kitchen extractor fan hums loudly until about 1am most nights; my log shows 14 nights since 1 September, and the vent is right under my bedroom window. I've never met the owner, Marco, and I'm going to drop a note in at the restaurant.
reply: Hi Marco, I'm Tara from flat 2, right above the restaurant. You probably can't hear it from the kitchen, but the extractor fan vent sits just under my bedroom window, and most nights it hums loudly until about 1am. Would it be possible to switch it off or turn it down once the kitchen closes, or ask your engineer whether it can go on a timer? Thanks, and do let me know if anything from our side ever causes you trouble. Tara, flat 2
note: A business below you gets the same friendly first note; keep the log, and if nothing changes, tell him before you go to the landlord or council.

situation: I'm Owen at 3 Mill Lane. Our neighbours at number 5, Rachel and Tom, have applied for planning permission for a two-storey rear extension, and the drawings show it running about 4 metres along our boundary, which would shade our kitchen and patio in the afternoons. The deadline for comments on the application is Friday 16 October; we've always got on, and I'd rather talk to them before I send any comment, maybe about stepping the upper floor back or keeping that part single storey.
reply: Hi Rachel and Tom, it's Owen from number 3. I've seen the plans for your extension, and I can see why you want the space. Looking at the drawings, the two-storey part runs about 4 metres along our boundary, and it would shade our kitchen and patio in the afternoons. Before I send anything to the planning team, I'd much rather talk it through with you: would you consider stepping the upper floor back, or keeping that part single storey? Could we have a cup of tea this weekend? The comment deadline is Friday 16 October, so I wanted you to hear this from me first.
note: Raise it with them before the formal comment, and tell them the comment is coming; check your council's guidance on what planning comments can cover.

situation: 我是302的小林。楼上402每天早上把刚洗好的衣服直接挂到窗外晾，水一直往下滴，落在我家阳台外晾的被子和衣服上，这周已经有三次得重洗。还没跟他们说过话，想先留张字条。
reply: 402的邻居您好，我是楼下302的小林，一直没正式打过招呼。您家早上晾到窗外的衣服会往下滴水，正好落在我家阳台外晾的被子和衣服上，这周已经有三次得重洗，您在楼上应该看不到。以后能麻烦您衣服多甩干一遍再挂出去吗？我们家要是有什么打扰到您的，也请直接跟我说。
note: 只提一个对方马上做得到的小请求，不要求别在窗外晾；没改善再找物业，并提前跟对方说一声。

situation: 我是502的小葛，阳台上晾着衣服，还放着几个藤椅坐垫。这个月有好几次在阳台上捡到烟头，9月27日有一个还没灭，把坐垫烧了个洞。看位置应该是楼上602在阳台抽烟往下弹的，我们没说过话，想先留张字条。
reply: 602的邻居您好，我是楼下502的小葛，一直没机会正式打招呼。这个月我在阳台上捡到好几个烟头，9月27日有一个还没灭，把藤椅坐垫烧了个洞，阳台上还晾着衣服，想想挺后怕的。看位置可能是从楼上落下来的，您可能也没注意到。以后在阳台抽烟时，能麻烦您用个烟灰缸吗？我们家要是有什么打扰到您的，也请直接跟我说。
note: 涉及火灾隐患：阳台一旦冒烟起火马上打119。字条没用再找物业，并提前告诉对方。

situation: I'm Ben at number 12. My neighbour at 14, Gary, wants to replace the whole fence between our back gardens with new 6ft panels and has asked me to pay half of the £2,400 quote. Our deeds don't say who owns that fence; apart from two leaning panels near our shed it looks fine from our side, and we'd rather keep it at the current height. I'd happily put £400 towards repairing those two panels like for like.
reply: Hi Gary, it's Ben from number 12, and thanks for asking before getting the work done. Apart from the two leaning panels near our shed, the fence looks fine from our side, and we'd rather keep it at the current height than go up to 6ft. I'm happy to put £400 towards repairing those two panels like for like. I wouldn't be able to go halves on the £2,400, but if you'd still like a full replacement, could we talk about the height first? Happy to chat over the fence whenever suits.
note: When the deeds don't settle ownership, offer a clear contribution rather than arguing about who owns it; check local rules on fence height before agreeing to anything.

situation: I'm Jo at number 6. Twice in the last two weeks I've seen our neighbour at number 8, Steve, put his rubbish bags in our wheelie bin the night before collection, so our own bags don't fit and the lid won't close. We only nod hello.
reply: Hi Steve, it's Jo from number 6. A small thing: a couple of times lately your bags have gone into our bin the night before collection, and then ours don't fit and the lid won't close. Could you stick to your own bin from now on? If yours is often full, it might be worth checking with the council whether a bigger one is available. Thanks, and let me know if anything from our side ever bothers you.
note: Say what you saw once, plainly, with a fix he can act on; a note stuck on the bin would be read by the whole street.

situation: 我是3栋201的小许，儿子今年高三，晚上在家复习。楼下广场每晚7点到9点有阿姨们跳广场舞，领头的是王阿姨，音箱正对着我们楼，关着窗也听得很清楚。我不想让她们别跳，只想请她们把音箱转向广场里面，8点以后声音调小一点。
reply: 王阿姨您好，我是3栋201的小许。大家每天晚上跳舞锻炼身体挺好的，我不是来说不让跳的。就是音箱正对着我们楼，关着窗也听得很清楚，我儿子今年高三，晚上要在家复习。能不能麻烦您把音箱转个方向，朝着广场里面，8点以后声音再调小一点？谢谢您！我们家要是有什么打扰到大家的，也随时跟我说。
note: 先当面跟领头的人说，只提两个她马上做得到的小调整，不提物业也不发业主群；没改善再找社区或物业，并提前跟她说一声。

situation: I'm Rachel at number 3. Our neighbour Mr Doyle at number 5 burns garden waste on a bonfire most Saturday afternoons, and the smoke comes over our garden and into the house; our washing smells of it and our six-year-old, who has asthma, starts coughing. We chat now and then. I'd like him to text me on 07700 900562 before he lights one, and he's welcome to put some of his garden waste in our green bin, which goes out every other Tuesday.
reply: Hi Mr Doyle, it's Rachel from number 3. You may not see it from your side, but when there's a bonfire on Saturday afternoons the smoke drifts right over our garden and into the house; our washing ends up smelling of it, and our six-year-old, who has asthma, starts coughing. Would you be willing to text me on 07700 900562 before you light one, so we can get the washing in and close the windows? And if it ever helps, our green bin goes out every other Tuesday and you're welcome to put some of your garden waste in it. Thanks, and do tell me if anything from our side ever bothers you.
note: Ask for a heads-up he can easily give, not a ban; check local guidance on garden bonfires before mentioning any rules, and if the smoke sets off an asthma attack, follow her asthma plan and get medical help.

situation: 我是1楼101的小陈，家里带个小院子，种了些菜。隔壁102赵阿姨家的白猫这个月几乎每天钻进我的院子，在菜地里刨土、拉屎，已经刨坏了两排刚出苗的生菜。平时见面会打招呼。我打算这周末在院子边上加一圈防猫网，想请她在网装好前的这几天尽量把猫关在家里。
reply: 赵阿姨您好，我是隔壁101的小陈。跟您说个小事：您家的白猫这个月常钻进我家院子，在菜地里刨土、上厕所，已经刨坏了两排刚出苗的生菜。猫爱跑也正常，我这周末准备在院子边上加一圈防猫网。网装好之前这几天，能麻烦您尽量把它关在家里吗？谢谢您！我们家要是有什么打扰到您的，也随时跟我说。
note: 猫很难完全管住：自己先做能做的，再只请对方配合几天，不评价猫也不评价主人。

situation: 我是801的小高。今天物业转告我，楼下701投诉我家每天早上6点多有咚咚的声音，应该是我早上在跑步机上跑步，我完全不知道会传下去。我已经买了减震垫，周一到货，从明天起早上不跑了，改到晚上7点到9点。想给701留张字条。
reply: 701的邻居您好，我是楼上801的小高。物业转告了您说的早上6点多的咚咚声，应该是我在跑步机上跑步，之前真没想到会传到楼下，吵了您这么久，很抱歉。从明天起早上我就不跑了，改到晚上7点到9点；减震垫也买了，周一到货。装好之后要是还能听到，您直接敲门或者留张字条告诉我就行。
note: 被投诉的一方：先认，再说清改什么、从哪天起；不追问对方为什么先找物业，只请以后直接找你。
